description: Cohort retention: of the visitors first seen on a given day, how many returned on each subsequent day.

endAt.description: Range end, epoch milliseconds. Overrides period.

filters.description: Optional Umami filter object to narrow the report, e.g. {"country":"BD"}.

period.description: Relative time range: "24h", "7d", "30d", "12m", or "today"/"yesterday". Defaults to "7d". Ignored if startAt/endAt are given.

startAt.description: Range start, epoch milliseconds. Overrides period.

websiteId.description: Umami website UUID. Use umami_list_websites to find it.

name: umami_report_retention
title: Retention report
